name: Ender 3 V3 SE printer tune-up and calibration

mentions.name: Ender 3 V3 SE printer tune-up and calibration
mentions.description: Tune-up and calibration of an Ender 3 V3 SE 3D printer, including fresh filament, cleaning, mechanical adjustments, and running through the calibration print suite included with OrcaSlicer.
mentions.problem: The printer had been sitting unloved (unused) for quite some time.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently, I'm in the midst of ricing my 3D printer - an Ender 3 V3 SE which has been sitting unloved for quite some time. Fresh filament, cleaning, mechanical tuneup, and now running through the very nice suite of calibration prints that are included in Orca slicer (which is new to me).
